goal: Issue #415 (Spec docs/specs/runtime-layering-boundary.spec.md). A contributor who adds an import from one host adapter into another, or from a host-neutral runtime module into any host adapter, sees bun test fail with output naming the importing file and the forbidden target; the five cross-host imports on main are carried as an exact-edge ratchet baseline owned by #413/#414. Test-only: no runtime import changes, no new tooling.

acceptance.assertion: Spec AC1 (BR-REQ-3, D2). In tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, scanning every .ts file under plugins/immune-brain/runtime/ outside runtime/claude/ and runtime/antigravity/ yields zero imports resolving into runtime/claude/, runtime/antigravity/ or .pi-extension/; a fixture non-host source importing ../claude/x is reported, while fixtures importing ../unattended/x or node:fs are not.

Spec AC2 (BR-REQ-4, BR-SCN-1, D1, D3, D6). In tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, the observed host-to-host edges across runtime/claude/, runtime/antigravity/ and .pi-extension/ equal exactly the five-edge baseline (antigravity/kernel_ports.ts -> claude/kernel_ports, antigravity/mcp_server.ts -> claude/mcp_server, antigravity/interaction.ts -> claude/interaction, claude/kernel_ports.ts -> antigravity/capability, .pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts -> runtime/claude/review_host), each tagged #413 or #414; a fixture edge outside the baseline appears in the unexpected list as a '<importing file> -> <target module>' repository-relative string; an adapter import of ../../runtime/assurance/x or an npm package is not an edge.

Spec AC3 (BR-REQ-5, BR-SCN-2, D8). In tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, the edge comparison function reports a baseline entry absent from the observed edges in its stale list as a '<importing file> -> <target module>' string, and identical observed and baseline lists yield empty unexpected and stale lists.

Spec AC4 (BR-REQ-6). In tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, the completeness guard reports nothing for the real host map (each of the three host directories exists and yields at least one scanned file), and reports a fixture host map entry whose directory is missing and one whose directory contains no .ts file.

Spec AC5 (BR-REQ-7, BR-DEC-4). In tests/runtime-layering-boundary.test.ts, the shared collector in tests/helpers/import_specifiers.ts reports the specifier of each form: import-from (including a multi-line named list), import type, export-from, side-effect import, import() call, type-position import('x').T, and require('x'), including the ../../runtime/claude/x path form; a non-import string literal such as const s = '../claude/x' is not reported.
Spec AC6 (BR-REQ-8, D9). tests/pi-canary-package-boundary.test.ts obtains import specifiers from tests/helpers/import_specifiers.ts and all of its existing assertions pass unchanged.
